title: A cover of the final algebraically closed point contains its identity
statement:
Let K be an algebraically closed field and e : X ≅ Spec K. Every covering sieve S of the final object id_X in the small pro-etale site of X contains the identity of id_X.
Definitions and coefficient conventions: [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

proof.text: A covering family has a nonempty weakly etale member. Over an algebraically closed field that member has a section. Compose with e to obtain a section over X. Downward closure of the covering sieve then puts the identity in the sieve.
